minutes.headline: Conservation Commission continued most hearings for better plans and approved a septic repair and a Northfield Road house lot.
minutes.summary: The commission heard wetlands filings at Hickory Hills Lake, Spring Street, Pleasant Street, Northfield Road, Holman Street and Electric Avenue. Most were continued to September 7th or 21st for revised plans. It approved a septic repair, two Northfield Road filings and a certificate of compliance. Members also discussed officer elections and supporting Richard Tremblay for the open seat.

public_comment.topic: Attorney for the abutter at 51 Spring Street raised drainage, an unshown historic trench, sump pumps and driveway paving concerns about 37 Spring Street.
Abutters across from the Northfield Road lots worried about runoff, questioned DEP approval and doubted the durability of rain gardens and drainage designs.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission approved a Pleasant Street septic repair with a standard order of conditions.
It approved a Northfield Road lot 5 house with erosion protection, after abutters questioned runoff and drainage designs.
It approved a Northfield Road lot A well and water line with a boulders condition.
Hearings at Hickory Hills Lake, 37 Spring Street, Electric Avenue, 509 Harbor Road and a dock were continued to September 7th for revised plans.
Holman Street lots 3 and 4 were continued to September 21st so the driveway can be moved out of the 50-foot zone.

why_it_matters: Approvals on Northfield Road and Pleasant Street set the wetlands conditions that govern runoff and septic work near abutting homes, while the continued filings stay open until revised plans are reviewed.
Residents near Spring Street, Holman Street and the dock can still be heard at the September 7th and 21st hearings, which are the next chance to shape those conditions.
